Mapo Party Room Blue Spring House Mapo is an emotional space with a sophisticated mid-century modern style interior.
As a complex cultural space with 7 floors, it can accommodate from 4 to a maximum of 50 people, making it suitable for both small gatherings and large parties.
The abundance of light coming in through the large windows shows the aspect of a ‘sunshine restaurant’ that produces the best results when taking photos.
Posters of famous paintings by Matisse and Munch placed throughout the space add to the luxurious atmosphere of a gallery.
There is a cost-effective ‘Sweet & Shot’ cafe on the first floor, so it is very convenient that you can bring drinks and desserts right to the party room and enjoy them.
A variety of bakery menus, including egg tarts, waffles, and macarons, are available to save you the hassle of preparing party food.
It is located on the main road connecting Hongdae and Sangam near Gajwa Station, so it is very easy for first-time visitors to find their way.
It is attractive because it is open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, allowing us to spend our own private time without being restricted by time.

reviews.author: Seunggu Choe
reviews.text:
After finishing the first and second outings in Mangwon-dong, I visited Pimak House for the third and final time. As the name suggests, it's a place with an attractive combination of pizza and beer, and it's open until late at night, so it was great to stop by without pressure. I think this would be a good option if you want to have a quick drink in Mangwon-dong.

There are a variety of pizzas available here, and I liked that you can order whole pizza as well as slice pizza or a set menu, so you can choose flexibly depending on the number of people in your party or how full you are. We ordered the 'Quattro Cheese Pizza Set' at the top of the menu, and it came with a half pizza, french fries, and garlic corn salad, so it was a complete meal. There are quite a few types of highballs and wines that go well with pizza, so even people who don't prefer beer would have a variety of options.

The menu we ordered was served all at once on a large tray and looked very generous. However, I personally found it a bit disappointing that they put raw cheese on the pizza and then cooked it with a torch at the table. I tend to prefer pizza that is well-baked in the oven or oven. The amount of cheese in the Quattro Cheese Pizza seemed to be less than expected, but still, the fresh pizza and a cold beer were enough to take away the fatigue of the day!

Overall, I was able to enjoy Pimac comfortably in a large space, and I think it's a great place to have a good time with friends and family in Mangwon-dong. If you want to enjoy delicious Pimac in a leisurely atmosphere, we recommend ‘Pimac House’ Mangwon branch!
